title: Teen Titans #3
desc:
KYLE HIGGINS AND DANIELE DI NICUOLO REINVENT THE TEEN TITANS!

Another kid has gone missing, and this time it's one of the Teen Titans' own!

Eugene Choi was once a member of the mighty Shazam family, but now he's powerless and helpless to prevent Ascend's mission to stop the teen team. Could his disappearance reveal more about the organization's true mission?

Plus, Red Hood's search comes to a devastating end.
